Title: Sociopath and Code of Samiel : definition of "in combat"

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body:
> Name: Code of Samiel
> [HttB:R/B1]
> Cardtype: Master
> Clan: Salubri antitribu
> Cost: 2 pool
> Burn Option
> Unique.
> Put this card in play. During your unlock phase, a Salubri antitribu you control can gain 1 blood. If a Salubri antitribu burns a ready vampire or sends a vampire to torpor in combat or as a  action, that Salubri antitribu can unlock after the end of the minion phase.
> Artist: Peter Bergting
>
> Name: Sociopath
> [BH:C/PTr2]
> Cardtype: Master
> Master: archetype.
> Put this card on a Sabbat vampire you control. Once per turn, when this vampire remains ready and burns a minion in combat or sends a vampire to torpor in combat, he or she gains 1 blood from the blood bank. A vampire can have only one archetype.
> Artist: Fred Harper
>
Ok here are the card texts. Now, what is the definition of "in combat" for these cards. Does it means "during combat" or does it means "due to a combat card or a combat effect"

I would think it is the first one but it could be argued that a Catatonic Fear triggers these cards.

What seals the deal IMO is a card like Cobra Fangs.

A confirmation ?
>
> Name: Catatonic Fear
> [Sabbat:U, SW:U, FN:PS, CE:PTo, LoB:PI2, Third:U]
> Cardtype: Combat
> Cost: 1 blood
> Discipline: Presence
> Strike: combat ends.
> As above, and inflict 1 damage to the opposing minion once combat ends if the range is close.
> Artist: Clint Langley
>
> Name: Cobra Fangs
> [LotN:R, POD:DTC]
> Cardtype: Combat
> Cost: 1 blood
> Discipline: Serpentis
> [ser] Strike: hand strike. If any damage from this strike is successfully inflicted on an opposing ally, burn that ally after action resolution.
> [SER] As above, and if any damage from this strike is successfully inflicted on an opposing vampire, the opposing vampire goes to torpor during their next unlock phase.
> Artist: Mike Chaney
>

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
After combat is no longer "in combat". So Catatonic Fear or Cobra Fangs won't trigger The Code of Samiel or Sociopath.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body: Isn’t the damage from Catatonic Fear done in the step F “Combat Ends” (from the Detailed Play Summary) which is still part of the combat....meaning that if that damage sent a vampire to torpor it has then happened "in combat"?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> inm8 wrote:
> Isn’t the damage from Catatonic Fear done in the step F “Combat Ends” (from the Detailed Play Summary) which is still part of the combat....meaning that if that damage sent a vampire to torpor it has then happened "in combat"?
>
No, it's inflicted after the combat ends. (groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/KireUeOYY3c/m/nb81oLVJRyMJ) You couldn't play Disarm thanks to it for instance.

Messages.Author: inm8
Messages.Body:
Guess I found the answer on my own to my question ...  [RTR 19970630] states that the damage is inflicted after combat ends.

It’s because of what and how the word “once” means and how it is used...as a non-native english speaker I learned something today....would have been easier for us if “after” was used instead of “once”.
